headline: HOLD: 4 missing documents require resolution before proceeding
nextAction: AtliQ's deal team must obtain the missing MSA, NDA, and written client consent for subcontracting.

findings.title: Missing MSA with Ashwood Senior Living Inc
findings.impact: US healthcare work needs NDA + MSA + BAA before any patient data moves (HIPAA: every business associate and subcontractor needs a written BAA before PHI access. AtliQ Inc delivers through Pvt Ltd (Pune), which is itself a subcontractor.)

hits.heading: FEES AND PAYMENT
hits.label: standard
hits.text:
4.1 The total fees for the Services are **USD 48,000** (United States Dollars Forty-Eight Thousand only), payable on completion of Milestones as set out in Annexure A.

4.2 The Service Provider shall raise an invoice upon completion of each Milestone. The Company shall pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days of receipt of the invoice.

4.3 All fees are exclusive of GST. The Company shall be entitled to deduct TDS as applicable.

4.4 Any disputed amount shall be notified within ten (10) days of receipt of invoice, and the Parties shall resolve such dispute in good faith within thirty (30) days.
hits.differs: Better for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: invoices are payable within 30 days instead of 45 days.
